entry.title: Seedroller and keyderiver: cli tools to generate BIP39 seed words and derive BIP380 keys
entry.summary:
The email details the functionality of the `-r` option in a software tool, which is specifically designed to handle dice rolls and produce reproducible results. This function ensures that when the same sequence of dice rolls is input, the output—namely, the seed words generated by a sha256 hash—remains consistent. Such a feature is crucial for verification and testing purposes, where predictable outputs are necessary to ensure the tool's reliability and correctness.
Further examination of this tool's capabilities involves a comparison with the results generated by another tool available at iancolman.io/bip39. The sender references a specific unit test named [known_answer_100_rolls_no_os_entropy](https://github.com/bubb1es71/bitcoin-key-tools/blob/202a848866a666c9d855ff3157be32c1ecebd46c/seedroller/src/main.rsL474-L509), which presumably demonstrates how the tool performs under controlled conditions to align with expected outcomes. This reference is crucial for understanding the application’s accuracy and reliability in real-world scenarios, comparing it to established standards or tools in the field.
